origin.description: The hirose data frame has 44 rows and 3 columns. PET film is used in electrical insulation. In this accelerated life test the failure times for 44 samples in gas insulated transformers. 4 different voltage levels were used.
origin.details: This data frame contains the following columns: volt: The voltage (in kV). time: The failure or censoring time in hours. cens: The censoring indicator; 1 means right-censored data. Source: The data were obtained from Hirose, H. (1993) Estimation of threshold stress in accelerated life-testing. IEEE Transactions on Reliability, 42, 650--657. Davison, A.C. and Hinkley, D.V. (1997) Bootstrap Methods and Their Application. Cambridge University Press.
origin.value: A data frame with 44 rows and 3 columns: volt, time, cens.
